description: Semantic search across 1+ million vectors across Nordic financial data for AI agents. Covers company filings (annual and quarterly reports), exchange announcements, and press releases from Norway, Sweden, Denmark and Finland — plus macroeconomic data including interest rates, GDP, CPI, housing prices, credit growth, commodity prices (shipping, salmon, oil), energy prices (ENTSO-E day-ahead spot prices for all Nordic bidding zones), and FX rates. Hybrid dense+sparse retrieval with cross-encoder reranking. Updated nightly.
